section.heading: Proof required for each registered vehicle.
section.text: No vehicle shall be or continue to be registered in the name of any person required to file proof of financial responsibility unless such proof shall be furnished for such vehicle.

annotations.annotation: Applicability of D.C. Law 25-161: § 8 of D.C. Law 25-161 provided that the change made to this section by § 3(i) of D.C. Law 25-161 is subject to the inclusion of the law’s fiscal effect in an approved budget and financial plan. Therefore that amendment has not been implemented.

Section 7254(a) of D.C. Law 26-189 repealed section 8(d) of D.C. Law 25-161, thus amending the applicability limitation. Therefore the amendments made to this section by section 3(i) of D.C. Law 25-161 have been implemented.
